scope: Additive Builder's Hut multi-Builder repair-efficiency value; no Builder actor is enabled.
game_version: Official Builder lifecycle pages and an unversioned secondary efficiency table consulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: Battle Builders!
sources.limitations: Confirms the non-targetable repair role, spell responses and stopping when the Hut is destroyed, but not multi-Builder efficiency or deterministic target/path order.

sources.title: Builders & Builder's Huts
sources.limitations: Confirms that upgraded Huts deploy a Builder to repair defensive buildings and that it retreats on Hut destruction, without selecting a repair target or defining movement/collision/order.

sources.title: Builder's Hut
sources.limitations: Reports added-Builder effectiveness of 100%, 100%, 90%, 90%, and 70% for total Builder counts 1–5. It gives no current build, target-selection trace, path, collision, per-tick allocation or simultaneous-event ordering.

value.multi_builder_value_status: secondary inventory value only; no allocation rule materialized

partial_mechanics_contract.note: The efficiency table extends, rather than replaces, the existing data-only Builder contract; it does not fabricate a Builder entity or allocation algorithm.

known_uncertainties: The table gives aggregate efficiency only; it does not determine which Builders choose a target, when they join/leave it, how fractional output rounds per tick, or how the result interacts with damage, spells and Hut destruction.
conclusion: Builder's Hut now retains the available multi-Builder efficiency table with provenance. Builder lifecycle and repair behavior remain data-only until target, path, collision and ordering evidence is reproducible.
